claim: In the matching retail DLL, Referee.InitRound (0x0600507A) is an instance method with one Int32 parameter named rd and an exact 244-byte body; the emitted body never loads rd. It loads GlobalWork.inst.MatchSetting into a local. For Referee.PlPos, x is written raw 0.0f on every path; y is written raw 1.0f when MatchSetting.BattleRoyalKind is raw 0 or raw 4, and raw 0.0f for other nonzero raw BattleRoyalKind values. The next branch tests BattleRoyalKind and MatchSetting.isFastForwardMatch: only when BattleRoyalKind is raw 0 and isFastForwardMatch is zero does the method store raw State 22 and call FACT-0068 Referee.ReqRefereeAnm(1106). Otherwise it stores raw State 19, calls FACT-0068 Referee.ReqRefereeAnm(1121), then calls Referee.UpdateRefereeAnm(). The shared tail writes PlPos.z=1.0f, Counter=0, plIdx_FirstWiner=-1 and standPoseTimer=0, then returns.
